local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local pCity = CityManager.GetCity(me, 16777217 % 65536) if pCity == nil then print("ERR:CITY_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local gov = GameInfo.Governors["GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL"]
if gov == nil then print("ERR:GOVERNOR_NOT_FOUND|GOVERNOR_THE_CARDINAL"); print("---END---"); return end
if PlayerOperations.ASSIGN_GOVERNOR == nil then print("ERR:API_MISSING|PlayerOperations.ASSIGN_GOVERNOR is nil"); print("---END---"); return end
local params = {}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE] = gov.Index
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST] = pCity:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE] = me
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(me, PlayerOperations.ASSIGN_GOVERNOR, params)
print("OK:ASSIGNED|" .. Locale.Lookup(gov.Name) .. " to " .. Locale.Lookup(pCity:GetName()))
print("---END---")
